* docs(catalog): Fifth Edition deliverable catalog — 2026-08-25

Adds deliverable-catalog-2026-08-25.html (Fifth Edition) reflecting
the estate's current state:

- 15 catalogued repositories: Froi-Browser promoted to full entry #08
  following Phase 7 SSO Identity Rail merge (2026-08-22)
- lane-mcp: 46 tools across 16 modules, SSO Phase 16 (Google/Microsoft/
  Apple/Amazon/Meta/GitHub OAuth 2.0/OIDC with PKCE)
- 10-stage estate pipeline (added lockfile_orphan_audit phantom-fix
  detection stage and proprietary dependable-bot upgrade)
- Government Phase 6: EPA/DEQ + DOT/FMCSA data subsystems
- MacroHarder: 94/94 Rust tests, IPI Modifier Calculator Phase 15
- 205+ passing Rust tests estate-wide (up from 179+)
- 14 novel design system entries (LaneVM #13, SSO Module #14 added)
- SSO Identity Tower added to isometric SVG city rendering
- Mock dashboard updated: Government RISK_PROFILE + SSO_IDENTITY_RAIL panels

Updates docs/catalog/README.md pointer from Fourth to Fifth Edition.
All prior editions retained unchanged.
